steps.en: Summons number search field exists but only runs in staging
steps.id: Field pencarian summons number ada tapi hanya jalan di staging
steps.why_en: Generic notice search; the summons lookup has no backend in the repo and is off outside staging.
steps.why_id: Pencarian notice umum; pencarian summons tidak punya backend di repo dan mati di luar staging.

steps.en: ID number search finds the offender's notices
steps.id: Pencarian ID number menemukan notice milik offender
steps.why_en: It lists general notices, not summonses prepared for an AOS.
steps.why_id: Hasilnya notice umum, bukan summons yang disiapkan untuk AOS.

steps.en: Batch number search is not available to the officer
steps.id: Pencarian batch number belum bisa dipakai officer
steps.why_en: A helper exists but is not connected to any search screen or backend.
steps.why_id: Fungsi bantu ada tetapi tidak tersambung ke layar pencarian atau backend.

steps.en: Court mention date range fields exist in the search form
steps.id: Field rentang court mention date ada di form pencarian
steps.why_en: The service behind this search is not in the repo and results are general notices.
steps.why_id: Layanan di balik pencarian ini tidak ada di repo dan hasilnya notice umum.
